decision.original_human_message: Je valide P152-153-annotated-chunking pour la conservation observée, avec les réserves indiquées. Enregistre ma décision et fais le bilan de cette revue. Aucun LLM, API payante, commit ni push.
decision.approved_scope: Observed conservation and correct placement of the already approved documentary annotations in these exact v2 K0/K800 outputs, with physical isolation of the three unresolved aggregate rows.
reservations: This reviews conservation and exact scope in the new outputs, without reopening or expanding source-document approvals.
Forty derived data rows are primary and three aggregate rows are isolated for quarantine; all source text remains in the unchanged document.
The three quarantines remain unresolved for per-variant interpretation; 43 derived rows are not 46 independently reconstructed physical variant lines.
Only explicit note-link elements establish applicability. Other rows co-occurring in a fragment do not inherit its note bodies.
The separate eight-item source-text inventory preserves all note bodies but is not a retrieval unit or a source of cell applicability.
Full reservations/provenance are in the SHA-bound annotation sidecar; the XML also contains concise limitations. No blanket scientific approval is implied.
Structural XML v2 remains experimental; the cap covers serialized XML alone, not a complete prompt or assembled query.
No production retrieval, answer quality, current product availability, graph publication or scientific performance is validated.
